verdict.rationale: Exa's API and SDK explicitly support the full research pipeline: search, content extraction (with token-efficient highlights), structured output/answer generation, and agent tool integration (webSearch, exa.answer, MCP server for Claude/Cursor/etc.), all callable through one unified API. Community feedback confirms real usage of the search API for agentic workflows, though some quality/reliability caveats exist (e.g., missing fields, slower verification steps in Websets).
